requirements.text: that "E-Commerce Website" service that went down? I believe it's back now
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service WHERE service_id = 'SVC_007' AND name = 'E-Commerce Website' AND status = 'operational'
requirements.source: Verify Service Status Update to Operational
assumptions: implied by the request ('I believe it's back now'), not stated; update_service is listed and SVC_007 sits at repair_in_progress on the seed
SVC_007 resolved from the seed by name 'E-Commerce Website' (one match)
status operational kept from the benchmark check; the seed's service statuses are operational, ready, repair_in_progress, non-operational and retired
name kept from the benchmark check as an identity guard; not fixed by request or policy

requirements.text: swapped out the database configuration item with serial number "SRV-ORC-9981" for a new one apparently the new hardware specs use serial number "DB-2025-PROD-001"
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_item WHERE configuration_item_id = 'CI_001' AND serial_number = 'DB-2025-PROD-001'
requirements.source: Verify Configuration Item Serial Number Update
assumptions: CI_001 resolved from the seed by serial SRV-ORC-9981 (one match, status in_use; no CI carries DB-2025-PROD-001 on the seed)
read as updating the existing CI's serial number, as the article content says and as the only CI-writing tool (update_configuration_item) allows, not as creating a second CI

requirements.text: we need a knowledge article titled "E-Commerce Service Restoration Procedure" and article content "..." ... it should be accessible, visible to the public

cells.title: E-Commerce Service Restoration Procedure
body: LIKE '%serial number was updated to DB-2025-PROD-001%'

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 'KB_026' AND title = 'E-Commerce Service Restoration Procedure' AND state = 'published' AND visibility = 'external' AND owner_id = 'USER_004' AND org_id = 'ORG_001' AND body LIKE '%E-Commerce Website Service Restoration Procedure%' AND body LIKE '%serial number was updated to DB-2025-PROD-001%' AND body LIKE '%servicedesk@techcorp.com%'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (KB_026 after KB_025)
state published: 'accessible' read with policy section 7 (only published articles are searchable by reporters); also the benchmark check's value
visibility external: 'visible to the public'; the seed's visibility values are internal and external
owner_id USER_004 is the acting user and the content's named author; org_id ORG_001 is her organisation in the seed

body tested by three fragments from separate lines rather than the full text: the request writes literal backslash-n sequences between paragraphs, and whether an agent stores them as newlines is undecidable

disagreement: body's second fragment: A LIKE '%serial number was updated to DB-2025-PROD-001%', B LIKE '%DB-2025-PROD-001%'; chose the longer fragment because both are quoted from the request's content, which lies within one line, and it is the tighter of the two

Verify Knowledge Article Creation.evidence: the check's description says 'internal visibility' but its query tests visibility = external, which matches the request's 'visible to the public'; the query is kept as written

notes:
disagreement: value: the knowledge body's second fragment, the serial number alone in one pass and the full clause 'serial number was updated to DB-2025-PROD-001' in the other; kept the full clause because it is quoted from one line of the request's content and is the tighter predicate.
The knowledge requirement adds a body cell the benchmark did not test, since the request fixes the content. The acting user USER_004 holds role manager (users.role and user_role ROLE_003); policy section 2 gives managers full CRUD only on incident, problem, change and knowledge, with read access elsewhere, so a strict reading would refuse the CI and service updates; the benchmark checks expect both and update_configuration_item and update_service are listed, so the checks are kept as the prior. No stay requirements: nothing is forbidden, and SRV-ORC-9981 matches one CI with no near match on the seed.
